test_substitutes: Synthetic GTF, archived GDC metadata and count files; original R statistical producers.
No learned fitting or learned-output substitute in the annotation-to-expression integration.
scope_limit: Added an immutable host149 GENCODE GTF-to-bulk-annotation producer, retaining all gene records, versioned/PAR-Y identities, symbols, biotypes, coordinates and original line numbers. Header build/release declarations and every output cell are reconstructed from pinned raw bytes. Native expression checks STAR gene/version/name/type membership against this table, and original sample assembly still enforces identical metadata across samples. Actual original R count/TMM/ssGSEA, candidate and detection producers consume the table through annotation.run -> expression.run; model-use candidate/activity inspectors follow its sidecar to raw GTF without inventing patient-study evidence. The chain has 30 operations. Reference acquisition/authenticity, alignment build veracity, SC/genomic annotation ancestry and other full-source/external-acceptance gaps remain explicit. Synthetic-only checks ran on149, no fitting, real cohorts, acquisition, paid compute or deployment.
